title: Turbocharger Bypass Valve Control Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: turbocharger bypass valve control circuit fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates turbocharger bypass valve control circuit fault. The PCM monitors commanded vs. actual boost and the bypass/wastegate solenoid duty cycle; persistent deviation matures the code.

Limp mode and reduced power are common until the fault is corrected.
safetyImpact: Limp mode possible; reduced power can be unsafe in highway merging.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect related sensors, harness, connectors, and components for damage, corrosion, or contamination.

fixSteps.title: Electrical/functional test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector; perform manufacturer-specific actuator/monitor test.

fixSteps.title: Replace component or perform service procedure
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect component or perform required relearn and clear codes.

faq.a: Drive cautiously to a shop; avoid hard acceleration and high boost.
No - solenoid, actuator, or boost-leak repair is required.

title: Turbocharger Boost Sensor A Circuit Low
shortDescription: PCM detected: turbocharger boost sensor a circuit low fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates turbocharger boost sensor a circuit low fault. The PCM compares boost-sensor voltage against expected pressure and flags faults when readings are out of range or implausible.

Limp-mode operation is likely until the sensor or its plumbing is corrected.
safetyImpact: Loss of boost can cause sudden power drop; merge and pass with caution.

causes.cause: Vacuum/boost reference line leak or kink

title: Engine Oil Over Temperature
shortDescription: PCM detected: engine oil over temperature fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates engine oil over temperature fault. The PCM monitors oil temperature and triggers when the value exceeds the calibrated upper threshold for protection.

Ignoring the warning risks bearing damage and turbocharger failure.
safetyImpact: Continued operation at high oil temperature can cause severe engine damage.

title: Cold Start Crankcase Pressure Sensor Performance
shortDescription: PCM detected: cold start crankcase pressure sensor performance fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates cold start crankcase pressure sensor performance fault. The PCM commands EVAP purge/vent and watches tank pressure decay; failure to seal or purge correctly matures the code.

The primary impact is failed emissions inspection.
safetyImpact: No immediate safety risk; emissions impact only.

title: Thermostat Heater Control Circuit Low
shortDescription: PCM detected: thermostat heater control circuit low fault.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates thermostat heater control circuit low fault. The PCM monitors the relevant circuit or actuator and flags persistent out-of-range or rationality faults.

Diagnostic scan-tool data is required to confirm the root cause before parts are replaced.
safetyImpact: May trigger limp-mode; drive gently to a shop.

causes.cause: Sensor or actuator out of range
